A two-minute walkthrough

Three questions. One decision studio.

01
Where do users get stuck?

Start in Overview. Filter acquisition groups and follow the activation trend and signup-to-publish funnel.

02
What should we change?

Open Channel lab to inspect 43 acquisition channels and test a constrained, assumption-based budget allocation.

03
Do we have enough evidence?

Visit Experiment lab for confidence intervals, sample planning and retention guardrails. Check Cohorts and Methods to audit the reasoning.

All records are synthetic. The app is inspired by commercial analytics work, and makes no claim about real client or employer outcomes.
